name: pi-rsi-loop
description: Generic closed-loop RSI engine: SENSE->PROPOSE->FILTER->EXPERIMENT->GATE->APPLY->CURRICULUM->LOOP over six pluggable ports (LedgerSource, Proposer, ExperimentRunner, Gate, Applier, Curriculum); framework owns budget caps, two-strikes infra breaker, crash-resume (terminal results only), observe/live gating, rejection memory. Copy-adapted from the MC-proven closed_loop.py.
